sources.source: Broadband complaints fall to record low
sources.role: Quarterly complaint rates are service-quality indicators. They do not establish physical broadband availability, live orderability or parcel-measured speed.

sources.source: Comparing customer service: choosing the best home broadband, mobile and landline provider
sources.role: Customer-service comparisons, satisfaction measures and provider fault statistics are not selected-parcel coverage or measured-speed evidence.

sources.source: Quicker complaints resolution for telecoms customers, under new Ofcom rules
sources.role: Complaint-resolution rules concern consumer redress, not physical broadband coverage, orderability or selected-parcel performance.

sources.source: Broadband and landline faults and problems
sources.role: Consumer troubleshooting and in-home factors do not establish network availability or measured speed for a selected parcel.
Quarterly market volumes and revenues are aggregate sector statistics and cannot verify selected-parcel serviceability or speed.

sources.source: Social tariffs: Cheaper broadband and phone packages
sources.role: Tariff eligibility, prices and advertised speeds are affordability information; they do not establish physical coverage or measured parcel speed.
